name: Sheshai
overview: Sheshai is identified in Scripture as one of the three sons of Anak who lived in Hebron, a city with historical significance predating Egypt's Zoan. The presence of Sheshai alongside his brothers Ahiman and Talmai highlights the formidable inhabitants Caleb and the tribe of Judah faced as they sought to possess the Promised Land. Ultimately, Sheshai and his brothers were driven out and slain by Judah, demonstrating God's provision and the faithfulness of His people in overcoming the giants that opposed them.
